name: Potion
description: Active consumable: restores 12 HP.

name: Super Potion
description: Active consumable: restores 25 HP.

name: Hyper Potion
description: Active consumable: restores 45 HP.

name: Max Potion
description: Active consumable: fully restores HP.

name: Full Heal
description: Active consumable: cures any non-volatile Status Condition.

name: Paralyze Heal
description: Active consumable: cures Paralysis (PAR).

name: Reviver Seed
description: Rare PMD treasure: restores 50% Max HP and clears status when used or triggered.

name: Evolution Stone
description: Promotes a Stage-1 Pokémon at Level 10+ to Stage 2 (or Eevee at Level 15+).

name: Evolution Gem
description: Promotes a Stage-2 Pokémon at Level 20+ into its final Stage-3 form.

name: X Attack
description: Grants +3 Attack for the remainder of the current battle.

name: X Defense
description: Grants +3 Defense for the remainder of the current battle.

name: X Sp. Atk
description: Grants +3 Sp. Atk for the remainder of the current battle.

name: X Sp. Def
description: Grants +3 Sp. Def for the remainder of the current battle.

name: X Speed
description: Grants +3 Speed (+6% Avoid) for the remainder of the current battle.

name: Dire Hit
description: Grants +20% Critical Hit Rate for the remainder of the current battle.

name: HP Up
description: Very rare vitamin: permanently increases a Pokémon's Max HP by +3.

name: Protein
description: Very rare vitamin: permanently increases a Pokémon's Attack by +2.

name: Iron
description: Very rare vitamin: permanently increases a Pokémon's Defense by +2.

name: Calcium
description: Very rare vitamin: permanently increases a Pokémon's Sp. Atk by +2.

name: Zinc
description: Very rare vitamin: permanently increases a Pokémon's Sp. Def by +2.

name: Carbos
description: Very rare vitamin: permanently increases a Pokémon's Speed by +2.

name: PP Up
description: Very rare vitamin: permanently increases a chosen move's per-battle PP by +3.
